statement: ∀ τ α β : ℝ, 0 < τ → ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ τ * |α|
proof:
intro τ α β hτ
rw [yui_aux_0009 T gamma R, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ]
have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := τ) (C := τ * |α|) (f := fun t => (KdVPlan.phase α t - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β t) (by
  intro t ht
  rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hτ.le] at ht
  simpa only [norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, mul_one] using (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R τ α hτ).1 t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
simp only [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hτ] at h
calc
  τ⁻¹ * _ ≤ τ⁻¹ * (τ * |α| * τ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (inv_nonneg.mpr hτ.le)
  _ = τ * |α| := by field_simp; ring
